event_timed_xor_all_day.name: event_timed_xor_all_day
event_timed_xor_all_day.value:
("event"."all_day" AND "event"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."end_date" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."end_date" > "event"."start_date"
           AND "event"."starts_at" IS NULL AND "event"."ends_at" IS NULL)
       OR (NOT "event"."all_day" AND "event"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."start_date" IS NULL AND "event"."end_date" IS NULL
           AND ("event"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "event"."ends_at" >= "event"."starts_at"))

event_client_id_length.name: event_client_id_length
event_client_id_length.value: "event"."client_id" IS NULL OR char_length("event"."client_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

external_event_timed_xor_all_day.name: external_event_timed_xor_all_day
external_event_timed_xor_all_day.value:
("external_event"."all_day" AND "external_event"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "external_event"."starts_at" IS NULL)
       OR (NOT "external_event"."all_day" AND "external_event"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "external_event"."start_date" IS NULL)

reminder_event_offset_uq.name: reminder_event_offset_uq
reminder_event_offset_uq.where: "reminder"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reminder"."deleted_at" IS NULL

reminder_external_offset_uq.name: reminder_external_offset_uq
reminder_external_offset_uq.where: "reminder"."external_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reminder"."deleted_at" IS NULL

reminder_offset_needs_event.name: reminder_offset_needs_event
reminder_offset_needs_event.value: ("reminder"."offset_minutes" IS NULL AND "reminder"."event_occurrence_at" IS NULL) OR "reminder"."event_id" IS NOT NULL OR "reminder"."external_event_id" IS NOT NULL

reminder_client_id_length.name: reminder_client_id_length
reminder_client_id_length.value: "reminder"."client_id" IS NULL OR char_length("reminder"."client_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

task_time_needs_date.name: task_time_needs_date
task_time_needs_date.value: "task"."due_time" IS NULL OR "task"."due_date" IS NOT NULL

task_rrule_needs_date.name: task_rrule_needs_date
task_rrule_needs_date.value: "task"."rrule" IS NULL OR "task"."due_date" IS NOT NULL

task_client_id_length.name: task_client_id_length
task_client_id_length.value: "task"."client_id" IS NULL OR char_length("task"."client_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

habit_task_tag_uq.name: habit_task_tag_uq
habit_task_tag_uq.where: "habit"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "habit"."task_tag" IS NOT NULL

sleep_log_order.name: sleep_log_order
sleep_log_order.value: "sleep_log"."bed_at" IS NULL OR "sleep_log"."wake_at" IS NULL OR ("sleep_log"."wake_at" > "sleep_log"."bed_at" AND "sleep_log"."wake_at" - "sleep_log"."bed_at" < interval '20 hours')
